scope: 2D and 3D single-user local application; fixed grid and mesh counts are not capped by the workbench.

run.rssLimitDescription: Poll /proc RSS for this owned process group; terminate after the observed total exceeds the threshold. Sampling delay applies. This is not a hard memory limit and does not measure CUDA memory.
run.maximumProjectImportBytesDescription: No fixed byte cap for JSON project or replay imports.
run.artifactLimitDescription: Effective runtime value. WORKBENCH_MAX_ARTIFACT_MIB sets the per-run artifact and archive/package cap; default 4096 MiB, minimum 64 MiB, no maximum. GET /api/capabilities reports the effective value and whether it came from env or the default.

artifactPreflight.description: backend/preflight.py estimates the run-directory footprint before the worker starts using the effective WORKBENCH_MAX_ARTIFACT_MIB cap (default 4096 MiB). Estimates at or above 75% of the cap start with an artifactWarning; estimates above the cap return 422. Configurations with uncalibrated level-set exports are downgraded to a warning instead of a rejection.
artifactPreflight.validationContract: POST /api/projects/validate always returns valid=true for a valid project and adds an additive artifactEstimate field plus a warning string when the estimate is in the warning or rejection band.
artifactPreflight.runContract: POST /api/runs returns 202 with additive artifactEstimate (and artifactWarning in the warning band), or 422 with detail.code=artifact-budget-preflight when the estimate exceeds the cap.
artifactPreflight.lazySnapshots: VIENNAPS_WORKBENCH_LAZY_SNAPSHOTS=0 makes every step snapshot eager; the estimator then counts every snapshot instead of only the initial and largest one.

calibrationRuns.shape: 3D fin 5x5 um, gridDelta 0.05, 7 steps + volume mesh

artifactPreflight.formula: cells = x*y/gridDelta^2 (3D) or x/gridDelta (2D); states = cells * stateGeometryFactor * layerFactor * sum(160 + 18*i); initial snapshot = 300*cells*meshFactor*layerFactor; largest deferred snapshot = (300 + 75*weightedSteps)*cells*meshFactor*layerFactor. The raw sum is multiplied by safetyFactor. archiveEstimateBytes additionally counts every step snapshot.

run.maximumStepsDescription: No fixed step-count cap; memory, timeout, artifact and storage limits still apply.

storage.archiveSpace: The archive uses a streaming response; no second full-size archive is staged on disk.
storage.description: Effective runtime values. WORKBENCH_MAX_DATA_GIB (default 10, minimum 1, no maximum) caps total application data; WORKBENCH_MIN_FREE_GIB (default 20, minimum 0, no maximum) is the free-disk floor before data is accepted. A large artifact cap does not bypass either guard. GET /api/capabilities reports the effective values.

numerics.smallFeaturePolicy: Reject a positive physical feature smaller than 2 grid intervals; warn from 2 up to 5 intervals. A zero mask height disables the mask; a zero taper angle is valid. Trench geometry also requires a positive post-taper bottom width.

engineLimitsVsApplicationLimits.engine: Only verified API behavior is described in capabilities.json. No undocumented engine maximum is asserted.
engineLimitsVsApplicationLimits.application: Physical feature constraints and bounded runtime/storage controls remain; there is no fixed application grid, surface point, triangle, or snapshot JSON size cap.

memoryControlMechanism.finding: The sandbox exposes no usable cgroup memory.max. RLIMIT_AS is not used because it can conflict with CUDA address space and is not a GPU memory limit.
memoryControlMechanism.fallback: Process-group RSS polling and explicit termination only.

threeDimensional.notes: No fixed grid interval, surface point, triangle, or snapshot JSON size cap. Native mesh extraction and execution remain inside bounded_child.py process-group timeout/RSS/log supervision; the RSS poll is best-effort and does not measure CUDA memory. Run artifact and storage quotas remain.
